title: Mod specialists
description: Content/specialists.json: named scientists and engineers a country can employ. A country hires one for a one-off cost and pays upkeep every month while it is employed; while employed its effect lanes apply to the country. Each specialist works for one country at a time; the roster can start some of them with a country in a new game.

mode.description: "merge" (default) adds these specialists to the roster other mods define (an id an earlier mod already defines keeps that definition); "replace" discards the roster of the mods loaded before this one.

max_assigned.description: How many specialists one country can employ at once (default 2).

portrait.description: Mod-relative path of the portrait PNG, conventionally portraits/specialists/<id>.png. Must stay inside the mod folder.

country.description: ISO3 of the country that employs the specialist at the start of a new game. Empty = hireable by anyone.

available_from.description: First year the specialist can be hired (0 = from the start).

hire_cost.description: One-off cost in USD, paid from the treasury.

upkeep_monthly.description: Monthly cost in USD while employed.

requires_flag.description: Event flag a country must hold before it can hire this specialist.

ai_weight.description: Extra preference the AI gives this specialist when it chooses whom to hire.

effects.description: While employed. Only these lanes are available to specialists.
